steps.title: Lay the square sheet flat
steps.common_mistake: Start with a square sheet, not a rectangle.

steps.title: Fold corner to corner into triangle
steps.check_question: Is the paper folded into a single triangle with three corners?
steps.common_mistake: Line the corners up exactly before creasing.

steps.title: Crease both diagonals, then unfold flat
steps.common_mistake: Unfold both diagonals so the sheet lies flat with an X crease.

steps.title: Fold all four corners to center
steps.check_question: Is the paper a smaller square with four triangular flaps whose points meet at the center?
steps.common_mistake: Bring every corner to the exact center.

steps.title: Flip the paper over
steps.check_question: Is the side facing up a plain square with no flaps on it, only crease lines?

steps.title: Fold four corners to center again
steps.check_question: Is the paper a small square with four triangular flaps whose points meet at the center?
steps.common_mistake: Fold all four corners to the center again, on this side.

steps.title: Crease in half both ways, unfold
steps.common_mistake: Crease both halves firmly, then open it flat again.

steps.title: Flip, then push into four pockets
steps.check_question: Does the paper stand up in four separate pointed pockets instead of lying flat?
steps.common_mistake: Flip it, slide your fingers under the four flaps and push to the center.
